description:
This is a frog with the biological invisibility cloak. It lives in Central and South America and uses its powers to vanish in plain sight. Deep in the jungle, avoiding vicious hunters is a matter of life and death. But how does it work? How can a vertebrate be through? Where's the skin, where’s the flesh? Where are the organs? And how did it evolve to be like this? This is the glass frog.
